R for Journalism

I used R to explore a student performance dataset and examine relationships between different variables. I calculated basic statistics, created visualizations such as bar charts, dot plots, and histograms, and used correlation and linear regression to explore how reading scores and test preparation relate to math performance.

In [ ]:
# Step 1: Create histogram
h <- hist(
  exams$`math score`,
  breaks = seq(0, 100, 10),
  ylim = c(0, 300)
)

# Step 2: Add labels
text(
  h$mids,
  h$counts,
  labels = h$counts,
  pos = 3
) #h$mids：柱狀圖每個值得中心點（Ｘ軸上） #h$counts是每個y軸的數量 #adj=c(0.5, -0.5))決定標籤對齊方式，前面的是水平置中對齊，後面的是向上偏移
In [ ]:
h=hist(exams$`math score`, breaks=seq(0,100,10),freq=F,ylim=c(0,0.030))#freq=F（或 freq=FALSE）：將直方圖從「頻數（數據個數）」改為「機率密度」，把y軸從多少個據點改成機率密度
text(h$mids,h$density,labels=round(h$density,3), adj=c(0.5, -0.5),cex=0.8)  #h$density：只取機率密度為y值 #labels=round:四捨五入到小數點第三位

lines(density(exams$`math score`)) #line就是加上線條，讓他出現兩種視覺化功能

Correlation : tell how strongly two variables move together, -1 (perfect inverse) to +1 (perfect positive)

In [ ]:
# Correlation example--math&reading

cor(
  exams$`math score`,
  exams$`reading score`,
  use = "complete.obs"
)
0.817579663672054
In [ ]:
# Correlation example--math and preparation
exams$prep <- ifelse(
  exams$`test preparation course` == "completed",
  1,
  0
)
In [ ]:
cor(
  exams$`math score`,
  exams$prep,
  use = "complete.obs"
)
0.177702469304395
In [ ]:
aggregate(
  exams$`math score`,
  by = list(exams$`test preparation course`),
  FUN = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

more visualization with ggplot2

In [ ]:
colors <- c("#66c2a5", "#fc8d62", "#8da0cb") #先定義要什麼顏色！！

hist(exams$`math score`,
     breaks = seq(0, 100, 10),    #數字幾到幾之間，間隔為10
     ylim = c(0, 310),             #y軸是310
     col = colors[1],             #選第一個顏色
     xlab = "Scores",            #x軸標籤為
     ylab = "Frequency",         #y軸標籤為
     main = "Distributions of Math, Reading, and Writing Scores",         #標題
     border = "white")       #要用白色的邊框

# add = TRUE

hist(exams$`reading score`,
     breaks = seq(0, 100, 10),
     ylim = c(0, 310),
     col = colors[2],
     border = "white",
     add = TRUE)    #上面都一模一樣，只是顏色什麼的有變化，然後最後一定要add = TRUE，因為是要把數值疊加在原本的圖上面

hist(exams$`writing score`,
     breaks = seq(0, 100, 10),
     ylim = c(0, 310),
     col = colors[3],
     border = "white",
     add = TRUE)

legend("topright",                                   #legend加圖例！！   # 設定圖例外框樣式（1 = 有框線）
       legend = c("Math", "Reading", "Writing"),
       fill = colors,
       title = "Subjects",
       box.lty = 1)         # 設定圖例外框樣式（1 = 有框線）

       # box.lty = 0

Basic of ggplot2: Bar charts

In [ ]:
library(ggplot2)

p1 <- ggplot(exams, aes(x = `race/ethnicity`))#x軸為race的個數，geom_bar()為加總所有race的個數並且會製成chart
p1 + geom_bar()
In [ ]:
p2 <- ggplot(exams, aes(x = `race/ethnicity`, y = after_stat(count/sum(count))))

p2+geom_bar()+ ylab("Proportions") # proportion
In [ ]:
p2 <- ggplot(exams, aes(x = `race/ethnicity`, y = after_stat(count/sum(count))))

p2 +
  geom_bar(stat = "count", fill = c("skyblue", "pink", "lightgreen", "orange", "purple")) +
  ylab("Proportions") +
  labs(title = "Proportions of Race Categories")+
  theme_minimal()
In [ ]:
ggplot(exams, aes(x = math, after_stat(density),color=lunch))+geom_freqpoly()
